note: WIST-3 §3.2, §4: Epoch 1 of vectors/wist3/epoch.json's example Log is empty — nothing eligible — so its Checkpoint restates the previous tree size and root, one cadence later. The empty tree before Epoch 0 has size 0 and root SHA-256("") (RFC 6962 §2.1); the Consistency Proof from size 4 to size 4 is the equality of the two roots.
